'''7G sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]].<ref name="NoP" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that 7G sector was excluded from the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] due to it being an in-joke about Ilum's coordinates on the galactic grid.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 4.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
